description:
Call before you pay for a job another agent says it completed; release payment only on ALLOW. Work-check (VTR-1/W draft, class W1 declared): one signed ALLOW/REFUSE on a committed job before a buyer pays. Checks the
job was committed before execution, the agent is identified, a passing result was declared, the deadline held, and the log
leaf exists. The acceptance rule is declared by the agent, NOT re-executed by MIZAN in this era. Free; no key needed.
name: work_check
